newsitem.title: UK: Four killed in British motorway pile-ups.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in British motorway pile-ups.

text.p: Four people were killed and at least 62 injured, some seriously, on Monday in two separate motorway pile-ups in thick fog during the morning rush hour.

Police blamed the accidents on motorists driving too fast in treacherous conditions. At least 15 vehicles caught fire, including two trucks, when 60 vehicles collided on the M42 motorway near Birmingham, central England.

A petrol tanker carrying highly flammable benzine was close to the centre of the blaze, police said. Thirty minutes later another 30 vehicles collided on the same motorway. More than 100 firefighters were involved in rescue efforts.
